pr05CautionBody: This picture is built from authorised professional material and the details explored together. Recurrence helps surface supported professional meaning without turning it into personality traits or capabilities that apply in every situation. Observations remain tied to their contexts, and results are not automatically attributed to one person alone. This representation is not a personality judgement or a measure of suitability or readiness for a role.

landingHeroTitle: It knows you professionally. It helps you present your value without inventing you.
landingHeroIntro: IMAGO builds a grounded, reusable professional understanding of your path over time and uses it across its tools so you do not have to start from zero each time.
landingHeroNote: It does not assign you a score, and it does not treat as absent what it has not yet been able to observe about you.
landingEmergesTitle: What does “how you emerge professionally” mean?
landingEmergesBody: A CV often shows experiences one at a time. IMAGO reads them together and may recognize recurring professional situations, continuity across experiences, responsibility scopes and meaningful relationships between different episodes.
landingEmergesNotIdentity: What emerges is not a definition of who you are.
landingEmergesBoundary: It is the representation IMAGO can build from what it knows and can document at that moment.
landingAiAnalogy: The principle is similar to how AI systems build meaning by relating different pieces of information: not by looking only at each individual fact, but also at the connections between them.
landingAiGrounding: IMAGO applies this principle to your professional path while keeping every interpretation tied to the information it comes from.
landingFunctionsTitle: Discover what you can do with IMAGO
landingFunctionsIntro: Select an item to understand what it does. This is an overview of the same functions available in the application navigation.
landingFunctionProfileShort: Here you can see the materials you shared, professional information IMAGO has acquired and confirmed, and any preferences you declared.
landingFunctionProfileDetail: Your profile can be saved and restored with the information you have already entered and IMAGO has acquired. You can later add new documents, data and professional experiences and reuse, across IMAGO’s tools, what the system already knows about your path. This means you do not have to reconstruct your professional history from scratch each time. Materials and information → professional knowledge → new uses: as the profile grows on grounded information, you need to re-enter less for applications, professional directions and interviews.
landingFunctionRepresentationShort: IMAGO reads your experiences and professional information together to surface relationships, continuity and responsibility that may not be obvious from a single CV.
landingFunctionRepresentationDetail: A CV tends to describe experiences one at a time. IMAGO can instead read them together and identify connections, continuity and patterns that recur at different points in your path — for example similar responsibilities, situations you have faced more than once, or relationships between activities that might look unrelated when viewed separately. The resulting representation describes what emerges from the information IMAGO currently knows and can document: it does not claim to define who you are in absolute terms, but shows what your professional path makes visible from the information available. This reading concerns your path as a whole, not a specific role, and it is not yet separately shaped around the perspective of an HR professional, CEO or specific interviewer. By analogy, the principle resembles how an AI system can derive meaning by relating different pieces of information, without implying technical equivalence with its internal operation.
landingFunctionDirectionShort: Choose a role or professional direction to explore and IMAGO compares what that role requires with what it knows about your path.
landingFunctionDirectionDetail: IMAGO distinguishes what is already well documented, what is only partially documented, what still needs clarification and what is actually missing. Information not yet available is not automatically treated as a gap; when useful, IMAGO may ask a targeted clarification before drawing conclusions.
landingFunctionApplicationTitle: Prepare an application for a job opportunity
landingFunctionApplicationShort: Add a Job Description or specific position and IMAGO can prepare a targeted CV and cover letter, emphasizing the real experiences in your path that are most relevant to that opportunity.
landingFunctionApplicationDetail: IMAGO interprets the position requirements and reorganizes how your path is presented, giving more visibility to the most relevant experiences, responsibilities and results. The CV and letter stay coherent with your real professional history while being built for that specific opportunity.
landingFunctionEnrichShort: Add new experiences or clarify parts of your path that IMAGO does not yet know well enough.
landingFunctionEnrichDetail: You can come here directly, or IMAGO may suggest a clarification while you are exploring a direction or preparing an application. New information follows the appropriate acquisition path before becoming reusable professional knowledge.
landingFunctionInterviewShort: Prepare for an interview tied to a specific role or Job Description, with questions built around the role and your professional path.
landingFunctionInterviewDetail: IMAGO can simulate an interview for a specific position and help you work on your answers for the role you are preparing. Questions take the target role and your professional context into account. Practice remains separate from the Professional Profile: new information that emerges during a simulation is not automatically added to confirmed professional knowledge.
landingPrinciplesIntro: Four distinctions that keep the reading of your professional path clear.
landingPrincipleKnownBody: Professional information acquired and confirmed through the authorised paths.
landingPrincipleUnknownTitle: What it does not know yet
landingPrincipleUnknownBody: It is not automatically interpreted as absence, weakness or a gap.
landingPrinciplePreferenceTitle: What you prefer or are exploring
landingPrinciplePreferenceBody: A professional preference does not automatically become a capability or characteristic in your profile.
landingPrincipleTrainingBody: An answer given in a simulation does not automatically modify your professional profile.
landingPrinciplesSynthesis: IMAGO keeps knowledge, preferences, simulation and interpretation separate so that what belongs to your professional path is not confused with what you are only exploring.
landingGrowthTitle: A profile that grows with you
landingGrowthFlowAria: Materials and information, professional knowledge, new uses
landingGrowthBody: The more grounded knowledge IMAGO has about your path, the less information you need to re-enter when preparing new applications, exploring other professional directions or practicing for new interviews.
landingGrowthUpdate: You can keep updating the profile as your experience changes without losing what IMAGO has already acquired.
landingClosing: In IMAGO, your professional profile remains the point of continuity across every path.
landingStartProfileIntro: If you do not have a profile yet, you can add your first professional materials here. This utility remains secondary to the product overview.
landingFunctionImagoTitle: Welcome to the Beta version of IMAGO.
landingFunctionImagoShort: IMAGO is a tool dedicated to understanding and presenting the value of your professional path. Add your CVs — including previous ones — together with documents and information that describe your experience. Then choose a role or Job Description: IMAGO reuses what it knows about you to help you understand how you emerge professionally, explore new directions, prepare targeted applications and practice for specific interviews. Explore IMAGO’s functions and see how they can help at different stages of your professional path.
landingFunctionImagoDetail: Your Professional Profile grows over time and lets IMAGO reuse what it knows across its tools without making you start from zero. It knows you professionally and helps you present your value without inventing you: confirmed information stays separate from what is not known yet, preferences you are exploring, and what happens during interview practice.
landingImagoNotBody: IMAGO is not a test that assigns an overall score to a person. If it does not yet have a piece of information about you, it does not conclude that the corresponding experience, responsibility or characteristic is absent. A preference does not automatically become a capability, and what happens during interview practice does not automatically become professional truth.
landingContinuityAnchor: Your professional profile grows with you and remains the continuity point across all IMAGO tools.
landingHeroTitleLine2: It helps you present your value without inventing you.

betaFeedbackInviteAnytime: You do not need to wait until the end of the test: you can leave a comment at any time.
